bull_bear.body:
- Strong brand recognition - 'Kisan' and 'KML Classic' established as recognised brands in the plastic piping industry across plumbing, irrigation and water management
- Focus on value-added, higher-margin products - CPVC/uPVC fittings, solvent cement and allied products, with continuous addition of new SKUs in fittings and solvents said to improve the overall margin profile
- Two strategically located manufacturing facilities (Mahagaon, Maharashtra and Khadoli, Silvassa) supporting efficient production and timely servicing of customers across geographies
- Robust and expanding distribution network of depots, warehouses, dealers and channel partners, supported by exhibitions, dealer meets and plumber engagement programmes
- Customer-centric approach with after-sales support and continuous engagement with dealers, distributors, plumbers and end-users
- Breadth of a 'One-stop' piping product basket spanning plumbing, drainage, agriculture and rainwater harvesting
- CPVC products manufactured using high-quality resin and technology sourced from Japan
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

business.body: Kisan Mouldings Limited (KML) manufactures and markets plastic piping systems for water management, irrigation, water distribution and sewage disposal, principally CPVC and PVC/uPVC pipes and fittings used in residential, commercial, agricultural and industrial applications. Its portfolio spans CPVC and uPVC plumbing systems, soil-waste-rainwater drainage systems, drip and sprinkler irrigation systems, solvent cement and allied fittings, positioned as a 'One-stop' piping solution. Customers span architects, builders, farmers and individual end-users, served through a dealer and distribution network across regions of India.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Plumbing:** KML Classic CPVC Plumbing System, Free Flow uPVC Plumbing Pipes (ASTM)
- **Drainage:** Soil, Waste & Rain Water (SWR) system - Permafit range, SWR - Classic range (40mm to 200mm diameters)
- **Irrigation:** Drip irrigation systems, Sprinkler irrigation systems
- **Solvents:** Solvent cements for UPVC, CPVC and HDPE pipes (pet bottles, cans, carboys, barrels)
- **Fittings:** CPVC and uPVC fittings and allied products

business.title: Competitive strengths

outlook.body:
- Grow the share of value-added, high-margin products - CPVC and uPVC fittings, solvent cement and allied products - and keep adding new SKUs in the fittings and solvent segments to widen the range and improve the overall margin profile
- Strengthen operational efficiencies, improve manufacturing processes and push automation initiatives across operations
- Optimise and expand the distribution and dealer network across Indian markets through strategically located depots, warehouses and channel partners, supported by exhibitions, dealer meets and plumber engagement programmes
- Deliver 'One-stop' piping solutions backed by manufacturing capability, distribution reach and a customer-centric, after-sales-supported approach
- Leverage emerging opportunities through product diversification, customer-centric initiatives, operational improvements and strategic market expansion
- Strengthen brand positioning of 'Kisan' and 'KML Classic' in plumbing, irrigation and water management through consistent product quality and market outreach
- Boost near-term demand and sales through new strategies and programmes, focusing on innovation and 'market development' (building markets of the future)
- Manage the downside of low capacity utilisation through prudent demand-linked production planning and rationalisation of operational and overhead costs
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: The routed text discloses no capex project, capacity addition, commissioning schedule, debottlenecking programme or acquisition. During FY 2025-26 the Company operated its two existing manufacturing facilities - Mahagaon in Maharashtra and Khadoli at Silvassa - producing pipes, fittings, solvents and allied products for plumbing, drainage and irrigation systems; the MD&A states the Company processes approximately 20,000-40,000 MT of polymer annually. The only forward 'build-out' language is soft and non-project: enhancing automation initiatives and improving manufacturing processes across existing operations, continued addition of new SKUs in the fittings and solvent segments, and expansion of the distribution footprint through strategically located depots, warehouses and channel partners. No timeline, no rupee quantum and no named project is attached to any of these.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Outlook for the plastic piping industry is described as continuing to remain positive, supported by sustained government focus on infrastructure development, agriculture, irrigation, housing, sanitation and water management projects
- Increasing urbanisation, rising demand for affordable housing, expansion of water supply networks and growing awareness of efficient water management are expected to drive demand for plastic piping products and irrigation systems
- Government programmes - Jal Jeevan Mission and Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) with its 'Har Khet Ko Pani' and 'More Crop per Drop' objectives, plus housing and sanitation programmes - are expected to provide long-term growth opportunities
- Continued government emphasis on raising farmers' income, agricultural productivity and efficient irrigation, together with schemes expanding irrigation coverage and rural infrastructure, is expected to sustain demand for PVC pipes, fittings and micro-irrigation products over the medium to long term
- Formation and strengthening of Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) and promotion of modern farming techniques are expected to add to long-term industry growth
- GST and RERA reforms continue to favour organised players by improving transparency and operational efficiency within the sector
- Margin lever: increasing contributions from value-added and high-margin products, alongside distribution optimisation and wider market reach, is expected to support overall profitability and competitiveness
- Raw material prices are largely linked to crude-oil derivatives and remain volatile, which management says may impact profitability and operational performance
- Macro backdrop cited: IMF projects global growth at around 3.1 percent in 2026; India's GDP growth remained healthy in FY 2025-26 on manufacturing, services, infrastructure, consumption demand and improving rural sentiment

moat.body:
- Strong brand recognition - 'Kisan' and 'KML Classic' established as recognised brands in the plastic piping industry across plumbing, irrigation and water management
- Focus on value-added, higher-margin products - CPVC/uPVC fittings, solvent cement and allied products, with continuous addition of new SKUs in fittings and solvents said to improve the overall margin profile
- Two strategically located manufacturing facilities (Mahagaon, Maharashtra and Khadoli, Silvassa) supporting efficient production and timely servicing of customers across geographies
- Robust and expanding distribution network of depots, warehouses, dealers and channel partners, supported by exhibitions, dealer meets and plumber engagement programmes
- Customer-centric approach with after-sales support and continuous engagement with dealers, distributors, plumbers and end-users
- Breadth of a 'One-stop' piping product basket spanning plumbing, drainage, agriculture and rainwater harvesting
- CPVC products manufactured using high-quality resin and technology sourced from Japan

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Grow the share of value-added, high-margin products - CPVC and uPVC fittings, solvent cement and allied products - and keep adding new SKUs in the fittings and solvent segments to widen the range and improve the overall margin profile
- Strengthen operational efficiencies, improve manufacturing processes and push automation initiatives across operations
- Optimise and expand the distribution and dealer network across Indian markets through strategically located depots, warehouses and channel partners, supported by exhibitions, dealer meets and plumber engagement programmes
- Deliver 'One-stop' …

hero.oneLiner: Kisan Mouldings Limited is a BSE-listed plastic piping systems manufacturer serving plumbing, drainage, irrigation and water-management applications, processing approximately 20,000-40,000 MT of polymer annually.
